headline: NYY @ DET matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is NYY 3.75 at DET 4.23, with a projected total of 7.99. Batter research is strongest for Paul Goldschmidt, Anthony Volpe, Dillon Dingler, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Jahmai Jones, Max Schuemann because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
